## 9. Emission & Supply

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Total genesis supply | [`genesis_supply`](#param-genesis_supply) = 4,400,000,000 FLOP (no VC pre-mint, no auction) — three airdrops: [`genesis_miner_airdrop`](#param-genesis_miner_airdrop) = 1,200,000,000 · [`genesis_validator_airdrop`](#param-genesis_validator_airdrop) = 1,200,000,000 · [`genesis_agent_airdrop`](#param-genesis_agent_airdrop) = 1,200,000,000; plus the [`genesis_reserve`](#param-genesis_reserve) = 800,000,000 residual (ecosystem/incentives — funds the off-chain explorer referral leaderboard, periodic referral lotteries, builder programmes, and security-disclosure rewards; not an airdrop) |
| Era 0 block reward | [`initial_block_reward`](#param-initial_block_reward) = 96 FLOP/block (fixed per-block param; halves per schedule; no cap) |
| Split | [`miner_share_ppt`](#param-miner_share_ppt) = 75% miners · [`validator_share_ppt`](#param-validator_share_ppt) = 10% validators · [`agent_share_ppt`](#param-agent_share_ppt) = 10% agents · [`staker_share_ppt`](#param-staker_share_ppt) = 5% stakers (era 0: 72 · 9.6 · 9.6 · 4.8 FLOP/block) |
| Validator share | validator 10% pool, pro-rata by stake with [`finality_committee_premium_weight_ppm`](#param-finality_committee_premium_weight_ppm) = 1.1× for current finality-committee members; liquid on issue (§9.1 R9.13) |
| Agent & staker legs | 10% agent leg + 5% duration-locked community staking pool (7 lock duration tiers, zero slashing risk; no operator delegation) minted to protocol-derived sovereign pool accounts; onward payout mechanics in [E.40](#appendix-e--open-specification-items) |
| Labs/Foundation subsidy | separate mint of [`subsidy_per_block_per_recipient`](#param-subsidy_per_block_per_recipient) = 8 + 8 FLOP/block (`flop-subsidy`), halving with the reward across all 5 subsidy eras ([`subsidy_duration_blocks`](#param-subsidy_duration_blocks) = 315,360,000, ~10 years); 1,955,231,984 FLOP total (blocks `1..=315,359,999`, block 0 unrewarded per R9.7) |
| First halving | block 63,072,000 (Day 730) → 48 FLOP/block |
| Perpetual floor | [`floor_reward`](#param-floor_reward) = 3 FLOP/block from era 5 (block 315,360,000, Day 3650), forever |

### 9.1 Requirements

- **R9.1 — Block reward source.** The per-block reward **MUST** be sourced from
  `params/flop-protocol-params.yaml` ([`initial_block_reward`](#param-initial_block_reward), mirrored to
  `RewardInitialPerBlock`), **not** hardcoded or per-second. It follows the fixed halving schedule and is
  **not** subject to a governance emission ceiling above it — the genesis reward *is* the bound
  (`emission ≤ 96`).
- **R9.2 — Halving.** Emission **MUST** halve geometrically on block-indexed era boundaries
  `era(b) = ⌊b / H⌋` (`H` = [`halving_interval_blocks`](#param-halving_interval_blocks) = 63,072,000),
  floored: `96 → 48 → 24 → 12 → 6 → 3` after [`max_halvings`](#param-max_halvings) = 5, then
  [`floor_reward`](#param-floor_reward) = 3 FLOP/block forever. A distribution period `(last, now]`
  straddling an era boundary **MUST** price each produced block `b ∈ (last, now]` at `era(b)`'s rate.
  Because genesis block `0` is unrewarded (R9.7), era `0` comprises `H − 1` = 63,071,999 rewarded blocks
  (`1..=63,071,999`) and each era `e ≥ 1` comprises `H` = 63,072,000 rewarded blocks
  (`e·H..=(e+1)·H − 1`). Block rewards are liquid on issue
  (R9.13); airdrop grants unlock under §8.2 R8.7. Cumulative emission through the halving phase (end of
  era 5, block `378,431,999`, ~year 12) is `R₀·H·63/32 − R₀` = 11,920,607,904 FLOP (`2·R₀·H·63/64 =
  11,920,608,000` in the `H`-blocks-per-era closed form before subtracting unrewarded block 0); it reaches
  `2·R₀·H − R₀` = 12,109,823,904 FLOP (`2·R₀·H = 12,109,824,000` before subtracting block 0) at the end of
  era 6 (block `441,503,999`, ~year 14) — **not a hard cap**; the perpetual floor then adds
  [`floor_annual_emission`](#param-floor_annual_emission) = 94,608,000 FLOP/yr forever.
- **R9.3 — Subsidy.** The Labs/Foundation subsidy **MUST** be a separate mint (`flop-subsidy`), on top
  of — never part of — the block reward. Each of FLOP Labs and the FLOP Foundation **MUST** receive
  [`subsidy_per_block_per_recipient`](#param-subsidy_per_block_per_recipient) = 8 FLOP/block in halving
  era 0, and the rate **MUST** halve on the same 63,072,000-block boundaries as the block reward
  (`era(b) = ⌊b / H⌋`: 8 → 4 → 2 → 1 → 0.5 per recipient) and be exactly **0 from era 5** — the subsidy TERMINATES on the
  same boundary where the reward FLOORS (`b = 315,360,000`). Era 4's 0.5 FLOP is fractional in FLOP but exact in base
  units (5 × 10¹⁷), and the implementation **MUST NOT** truncate it. The exclusive sunset block is
  [`subsidy_duration_blocks`](#param-subsidy_duration_blocks) = 315,360,000 (`5·H`, ~10 years); with
  genesis block `0` unrewarded (R9.7), the subsidy mints on `315,359,999` produced blocks (`63,071,999` in
  era 0 and `63,072,000` in each of eras 1–4), so total minted =
  `63,072,000 × (16 + 8 + 4 + 2 + 1) − 16` = 1,955,231,984 FLOP (`1,955,232,000` in the `H`-blocks-per-era
  closed form before subtracting unrewarded block 0).
- **R9.4 — Genesis.** Genesis is work-first (no VC pre-mint, no auction, no team allocation).
  [`genesis_supply`](#param-genesis_supply) = 4,400,000,000 FLOP **MUST** be allocated to exactly four
  genesis buckets and nothing else: the three airdrops —
  [`genesis_miner_airdrop`](#param-genesis_miner_airdrop),
  [`genesis_validator_airdrop`](#param-genesis_validator_airdrop),
  [`genesis_agent_airdrop`](#param-genesis_agent_airdrop) (3,600,000,000 FLOP together, 1,200,000,000
  each) — plus the ecosystem reserve [`genesis_reserve`](#param-genesis_reserve) = 800,000,000 FLOP,
  which is a genesis allocation but **not** an airdrop (earmarked for off-chain explorer referral leaderboard payouts, periodic referral lotteries, builder programmes, and security-disclosure rewards, superseding on-chain referral commissions). The four **MUST** sum to `genesis_supply`
  exactly. The validator cohort is definitionally the aggregate bond —
  [`validator_min_stake`](#param-validator_min_stake) ×
  [`validator_active_set_cap`](#param-validator_active_set_cap) — so, when genesis parameters are
  chosen, a change to the bond floor moves this cohort and therefore `genesis_supply` (D-0440).
- **R9.5 — Committee premium.** The block-reward validator 10% pool
  ([`validator_share_ppt`](#param-validator_share_ppt) = 100 ppt) **MUST NOT** be increased by an
  emission surcharge or a second mint. (The separate 15% inference-fee validator share is an extrinsic
  settlement fee leg, not an emission or dilution of block rewards; see [Appendix D](#appendix-d--fee--revenue-map)).
  It is split inside the pool with weight `stake_i × (1.1 if i ∈ current finality committee else 1.0)`,
  integer dust assigned deterministically so payouts sum exactly to the pool. This holds unchanged under
  the four-way split: the agent and staker legs are carved **out of the miner residual**
  ([`miner_share_ppt`](#param-miner_share_ppt) 900 → 750 ppt), never added on top, so
  `validator_share_ppt` stays at 100 ppt.
- **R9.6 — Transaction-fee split.** Protocol-wide fee routing **MUST** operate with zero burn:
  [`tx_fee_burn_percent_live`](#param-tx_fee_burn_percent_live) = 0% burn (`BurnFees`), with the block
  author receiving [`tx_fee_author_share_percent_live`](#param-tx_fee_author_share_percent_live) = 100%
  of the transaction inclusion fee (base + encoded-length + adjusted-weight fee) and 100% of tips.
  Inference settlement fees likewise carry 0% burn (split 85% miner / 15% validator per §12.1 R12.1a).
  Full taxonomy: [Appendix D](#appendix-d--fee--revenue-map).
- **R9.12 — Agent & staker legs.** The [`agent_share_ppt`](#param-agent_share_ppt) = 100 ppt and
  [`staker_share_ppt`](#param-staker_share_ppt) = 50 ppt legs **MUST** be minted every distribution
  period to two protocol-derived sovereign pool accounts (`PalletId`, §9.3 R9.10 shape), one per leg.
  The [`staker_share_ppt`](#param-staker_share_ppt) = 50 ppt (5%) leg funds the duration-locked
  community staking pool across seven lock duration tiers with no slashing risk and no validator or
  miner intermediary. Onward distribution from either pool **MUST NOT** occur until its distribution
  policy is ratified ([E.40](#appendix-e--open-specification-items)); the pools accrue and the mint is
  evented. The two legs **MUST** be carved from the miner share, so the four legs sum to 1000 ppt with
  the validator pool unchanged (§9.1 R9.5).
- **R9.13 — Reward liquidity.** The miner and validator legs of every block reward, and the
  Labs/Foundation subsidy, **MUST** be liquid on issue: the protocol **MUST NOT** auto-compound them
  into stake, force-stake, vest, or otherwise lock them. The agent leg accrues in its sovereign pool
  under R9.12, and that accrual is not a lock; once its distribution policy is ratified
  ([E.40](#appendix-e--open-specification-items)), every agent-leg payout **MUST** be liquid on payment.
  Bonding a liquid balance as stake remains the holder's choice. The staker leg's liquidity remains
  E.40.

### 9.2 Survival governor *(default OFF, governance-armed)*

A state-dependent supply-side governor **MAY** be armed by governance to damp the exodus spiral near
collapse thresholds only ([`governor_default_enabled`](#param-governor_default_enabled) = false): a
**utilization-indexed emission damping** (lift miner reward when utilization is low; indexed on
utilization, **never price** — anti-Terra;
[`governor_emission_damping_util_floor`](#param-governor_emission_damping_util_floor) /
[`governor_emission_damping_max_boost`](#param-governor_emission_damping_max_boost)) and a **dynamic burn
schedule** (10→15→25% by era: [`governor_dynamic_burn_tier1`](#param-governor_dynamic_burn_tier1) …
[`tier3`](#param-governor_dynamic_burn_tier3)). The Day-730 participant-revenue cliff (miners 72 → 36,
validators 9.6 → 4.8 FLOP/block) is the first stress case; total per-block issuance falls by exactly
half there (112 → 56), because the subsidy halves alongside the reward rather than sunsetting. The
deepest total-issuance step is now Day 3650 (era 5), where the reward reaches its perpetual floor and
the subsidy terminates outright: 7 → 3 FLOP/block, a 4/7 ≈ 57.1% drop.

**Demand-coupled rewards (invariant).** PoUI **MUST** pay only for work with a payer-authorized demand
record, the applicable verification evidence, and settlement, or for the explicitly bounded
synthetic-task bootstrap floor. A payer-authorized record proves protocol demand; it does not prove an
economically independent customer. A miner-controlled payer can buy genuine inference and recycle much
of the payment while pursuing work rewards. Whether this is profitable depends on unrecoverable compute,
fees, capital, audit costs, reward and rebate schedules, and coalition ownership; the external-demand and
wash-demand model is [E.49](#appendix-e--open-specification-items).

### 9.3 Genesis configuration

The consensus-critical genesis essentials (the operational deployment runbook —
`GENESIS_AND_DESUDO_RUNBOOK` — stays separate).

- **R9.7 — Supply at genesis.** Total genesis supply **MUST** be
  [`genesis_supply`](#param-genesis_supply) = 4,400,000,000 FLOP (18 decimals), held at genesis **only**
  by the three airdrop cohorts and the ecosystem reserve of §9.1 R9.4 — no VC pre-mint, no auction, no
  team allocation. No block reward has been emitted at genesis; era 0 emission begins with block
  production.
- **R9.8 — Chain-spec constants.** Fixed at genesis and consensus-visible: **18 decimals** (base
  unit 10⁻¹⁸ FLOP); the user-facing ticker via `TOKEN_SYMBOL` (a mainnet branding step, §14.2); the
  **SS58 prefix** `SS58Prefix` = 42, the generic Substrate prefix, identical on every FLOP network (§6.5);
  1 s block time; existential deposit 0.01 FLOP.
- **R9.9 — Initial authorities.** The genesis chain spec **MUST** seed the initial validator set and its
  session keys (BABE + AlephBFT), bootstrapping the §2 finality committee. Post-genesis, `ActiveValidators`
  admits validators **only** through §15 rotation promotion from `ValidatorQueue` and through `un_jail` /
  `rejoin` restoration of jailed or extended-downtime-kicked validators within
  [`validator_active_set_cap`](#param-validator_active_set_cap) (§15.5, §15.7).
- **R9.10 — Protocol sovereign accounts.** The **FLOP Foundation** and **FLOP Labs** accounts are
  protocol-derived (`PalletId` sovereign accounts; mainnet **SHOULD** bind each to a multisig). They are
  the genesis-defined recipients/sinks for the Labs/Foundation subsidy (§9.1 R9.3), 100% of slash
  proceeds across all fault paths (§11.3, zero burn), and the failed-session penalty `φ` (§12.1d) — never
  miner revenue.
- **R9.11 — Bootstrap origin & de-sudo (one-way).** At genesis, Root is held by `pallet_sudo` (§14.1,
  index 50) — a public dev key on devnet, a multisig on mainnet. Governance is **not** the sole Root
  authority until the **de-sudo handoff** neuters and removes `pallet_sudo` and routes `RawOrigin::Root`
  to the `protocol_upgrade` track (§14.1). The production runtime **MUST NOT** expose a Sudo key or a
  non-governance Root path after handoff. An arbitrary governance-approved `set_code` can replace these
  guards; the claim is therefore scoped to approved runtime code (§14.1, E.50).

- **R12.1a — Reserved capacity and fee split.** Escrow at `open_channel` **is** the payment for
  reserved capacity; under-use **MUST NOT** be refunded. The only refund paths are a non-delivery
  timeout, an upheld fraud dispute, or a failed/early-terminated session (R12.1d). At settlement
  (`settle`, `certificate_settle`, or `force_settle → finalize`), the settled `payable` amount **MUST**
  be split: [`inference_fee_miner_share_ppt`](#param-inference_fee_miner_share_ppt) = 85% to the miner,
  and [`inference_fee_validator_share_ppt`](#param-inference_fee_validator_share_ppt) = 15% to the
  validator pool (D-0525). The 1% audit pool earmark
  ([`audit_fee_split_ppm`](#param-audit_fee_split_ppm) = 10,000 ppm) **MUST** be deducted from the 15%
  validator share to fund verification audits; the remainder of the validator leg is distributed
  intra-pool by the R9.5 weighting, liquid on issue (R9.13, D-0518).

proof's measured dm-verity root against the registry (`ModelRegistryQuery::verify_measured_root`); a
  wrong root at settle **MUST** reject. The SOFT profile has no TEE-measured root; its model/decode binding,
  evidence predicate, value cap, and dispute path are [E.33](#appendix-e--open-specification-items).
- **R12.1d — Failed/early close split.** On the unilateral `force_settle → finalize` path the earned
  tariff `P = BasePerTurn·n + rate_G·G_claimed` (flat per-turn payment over `n` turns plus claimed
  reference-work converted into payment units) forms the payable session settlement, which is split
  85% to the miner and 15% to validators (with the 1% audit pool funded from the validator leg) under
  R12.1a. `P` is denominated in the escrow's base unit (10⁻¹⁸ FLOP);
  [`channel_base_per_turn`](#param-channel_base_per_turn) and `rate_G` are each one base unit. `G_n` is
  the whole-reference-GFLOP integer from R4.4; the rate is a tariff price, not an assertion that one `G_n`
  equals one FLOP base unit. `force_settle` **MUST** reject with `TariffExceedsEscrow` when `P > E`; it
  **MUST NOT** clamp `P` or create negative payout legs
  (`pallets/pallets/compute-channel/src/lib.rs::{turn_tariff_pay,verified_work_from_turns}`). Otherwise,
  the agent is refunded `(1−φ)·(E−P)`, and the penalty `φ·(E−P)`
  ([`refund_penalty_phi_percent`](#param-refund_penalty_phi_percent) = 20%) **MUST** be transferred in full
  to `FLOPFoundationAccount` (§9.3 R9.10) with zero burn — never the miner. A miner-fault non-delivery uses
  `φ = 0` (full refund). Conservation:
  `P + (1−φ)(E−P) + φ(E−P) = E`. Caller restriction and tariff magnitude on this path are E.24.

| `inference_fee_miner_share_ppt` | 850 parts-per-thousand | [§12.1](#121-sessions--attested-streaming--aggregate-settlement) | D-0525 | #2702 (D-0525): Executive ruling (Shu, 2026-10-14). | | `inference_fee_validator_share_ppt` | 150 parts-per-thousand | [§9](#9-emission--supply) | D-0525 | #2702 (D-0525): Executive ruling (Shu, 2026-10-14). | | `audit_fee_split_ppm` | 10_000 ppm | [§9](#9-emission--supply) | D-0403 | #846, #2702 (D-0525): ratified 1% (10_000 ppm) of the settlement payment funded out of the 15% validator fee leg into the audit pool that pays validators for audit work. | | `audit_fee_per_turn` | 1 FLOP | [§12.1](#121-sessions--attested-streaming--aggregate-settlement) | D-0403 | #846: flat fee a VRF-assigned validator claims per audit verdict from the audit pool (claim_audit_fee), gated on submitted evidence and pool solvency (no unpaid-duty path). 1 FLOP placeholder; governance may recalibrate against measured audit cost. |

## Appendix D — Fee & Revenue Map

One **payer → recipient → sink** taxonomy for every money flow (informative summary of §4.2, §5.3, §9,
§11, §12). *Participant revenue* (miner/validator earnings) is named separately from *protocol runway*
(Labs/Foundation subsidy) and from *refundable deposits* (never revenue). Emission is **minted**;
fees/escrows are **transfers**; burns and Foundation receipts are **sinks**.

| Flow | Payer | Recipient | Sink / burn |
|------|-------|-----------|-------------|
| Block-reward emission (Era 0 96 FLOP/block; floors at 3 FLOP/block from era 5) | protocol mint | miners 75% (72) · validators 10% (9.6) · agents 10% (9.6) · stakers 5% (4.8) | — |
| Validator 10% split | (emission) | active validators by stake, 1.1× for finality-committee members, liquid on issue (R9.13) | — |
| Agent & staker legs (10% + 5%) | (emission) | sovereign pool accounts — 10% agent pool + 5% duration-locked community staking pool (7 tiers, zero slashing risk, D-0530); onward distribution parked ([E.40](#appendix-e--open-specification-items)) | — |
| Protocol-runway subsidy (+16 FLOP/block era 0; halves 16 → 8 → 4 → 2 → 1 with the reward) | protocol mint | Labs 8 · Foundation 8 — *not participant revenue* | terminates Day 3650 (era 5), where the reward floors; 1,955,231,984 FLOP total (`315,359,999` produced blocks `1..=315,359,999`) |
| Chain inclusion fee = base fee + encoded-length fee + adjusted-weight fee | tx sender | 100% to block author ([`tx_fee_author_share_percent_live`](#param-tx_fee_author_share_percent_live), `AllFeesToAuthor`); tips 100% author | 0% burn ([`tx_fee_burn_percent_live`](#param-tx_fee_burn_percent_live) = 0%, `BurnFees`, D-0529) |
| Session escrow settle | agent | miner 85% ([`inference_fee_miner_share_ppt`](#param-inference_fee_miner_share_ppt)) · validators 15% ([`inference_fee_validator_share_ppt`](#param-inference_fee_validator_share_ppt), of which [`audit_fee_split_ppm`](#param-audit_fee_split_ppm) = 1% funds the audit pool; validator remainder distributed intra-pool by R9.5 weight, liquid on issue per D-0518) | — |
| Session under-use (measured < reserved) | — | **no refund** — escrow **is** the price | — |
| Session non-delivery / upheld fraud | (escrow) | refund to agent | — |
| Failed/early close penalty `φ·(E−P)` | (escrow) | — | FLOP Foundation (`FLOPFoundationAccount`, zero burn per D-0529), never miner |
| DA ephemeral (quotes/proofs/transcripts/I-O) | — (path-gated) | — | **no charge** |
| DA leased-weights anti-spam deposit `bytes × DepositPerByte` | publisher | held, **returned in full** on prune/withdrawal — *never revenue* | — |
| Protocol/model DA byte fee (§5.3) | — | — | **none** — validator duty funded by reward share |
| Paid application storage (§5.4) | reservation payer | protocol-assigned validators at the epoch tariff: per-write setup after activation receipts plus fixed-term reserved capacity released per epoch against audit and checkpoint state | take-or-pay: deletion frees capacity for reuse, never refunds; remaining term transferable; separate fault remedies; no mint or service-fee burn |
| Paid application retrieval (§5.4) | authorized reader/payer | serving validators, by payer-signed cumulative service-lane vouchers over activated writes, acknowledged bytes and requests | unused allowance refunded; no mint or service-fee burn |
| Paid-storage metadata deposit / provider collateral | payer / validator | separate holds, never service revenue | release / objective fault disposition under E.54 |
| Slashing proceeds (all fault paths) | slashed operator / sponsor | FLOP Foundation (`FLOPFoundationAccount`) | 0% burn (100% transfer, D-0529) |
| Slash loss waterfall | slashed operator (+ any E.32 sponsor backing; third-party delegation prohibited per D-0530) | operator self-stake first, then any E.32 sponsors at the fault rate | Foundation (`FLOPFoundationAccount`) |

The base fee converts the extrinsic base weight with `WeightToFee`; the encoded-length fee uses
[`tx_length_to_fee`](#param-tx_length_to_fee), and the adjusted-weight fee applies the targeted fee
multiplier (floor 1) to `WeightToFee` of dispatch weight, using
[`tx_weight_to_fee`](#param-tx_weight_to_fee). The tip is additional to the inclusion fee. The
`flop-poui` inference-work price `(base+priority)·gflops/1000·precision_mult` (§4.2) is a separate
charge. Under D-0529, protocol-wide transaction-fee burn is 0% (`BurnFees = 0`) and 100% of inclusion
fees and tips route to the block author (§9.1 R9.6).

**Runtime-constant ⇄ SDK/explorer cross-map** and the residual indexer schema cleanup
(`reward_distributions` `burn_share`/`treasury_share`/`staking_share` vs. the emitted
`miner_share`+`validator_share`) are tracked as an implementation cleanup, not a protocol decision.
Provenance: `D-0435`, `D-0408`, `D-0403`, `D-0412`, `D-0407`, `D-0409`, `D-0421`, `D-0529`, `D-0530`,
`D-0531`. Grounding:
fee-design.md, miner-validator-economics.md,
agent-token-economics.md.

parameters.name: genesis_supply
parameters.raw:
- name: genesis_supply
    mutability: genesis-only
    on_chain: {source_only: Not exported as a FRAME constant; verified against source only.}
    value: 4_400_000_000
    unit: FLOP
    decision: D-0440
    rust: FLOP_TOTAL_SUPPLY
    lean: HalvingBoundary.genesisSupply
    quint: GENESIS_MICRO
    description: >
      Genesis (pre-emission) total supply, pinned normatively by R9.7 (§9.3). Components (D-0440,
      tokenomics workbook rev 2026-08-27; ECON-010 sec. 2.1): miner airdrop 1,200,000,000 + validator airdrop 1,200,000,000 +
      agent airdrop 1,200,000,000 + ecosystem reserve 800,000,000 = exactly 4,400,000,000. Each
      component is pinned by its own enforced param below, so the four cannot drift apart from
      this total. There are no genesis auctions, and Team is NOT genesis-allocated — Labs and
      Foundation receive a per-block subsidy instead (D-0421). D-0440 resized the pool 3,500,000,000
      → 4,400,000,000 to absorb the validator bond raise (validator_min_stake 305,505 → 1,200,000):
      the bond IS the validator cohort, so at the old pool the four components summed to
      3,600,000,000 and the residual reserve went NEGATIVE. Allocation history is in
      whitepaper/decisions/v0.4.md (D-0421, D-0435, D-0438, D-0440).
    implementations:
      - { file: ai-agent-simulator/params.yaml, expect: "total: 4400000000" }
      - { file: pallets/runtime/zkverify/src/genesis_config_presets/helper.rs, expect: "FLOP_TOTAL_SUPPLY: Balance = 4_400_000_000 * VFY" }
      - { file: README.md, expect: "4,400,000,000 FLOP" }   # narrative: Key Parameters table
      - { file: lean-proofs/FlopSpecs/Genesis.lean, expect: "def genesisSupply : ℕ := 4400000000 * baseUnit" }  # FG-20: Lean const bound to source-of-truth

parameters.name: initial_block_reward
halving_interval_blocks
max_halvings
parameters.raw:
- name: max_halvings
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {constants: [BlockRewards.MaxHalvings]}
    value: 5
    unit: count
    decision: D-0436
    rust: RewardMaxHalvings
    lean: Emission.maxHalvings
    quint: MAX_HALVINGS
    description: >
      Halvings before the reward floors permanently. Floor = initial >> max_halvings, so the
      ladder is 96 -> 48 -> 24 -> 12 -> 6 -> 3 and era 5 onward pays the 3 FLOP floor forever.
      D-0436 cut it from 6, superseding the sixth halving D-0421 added: the perpetual tail
      DOUBLES (floor_annual_emission 47,304,000 -> 94,608,000 FLOP/yr). This is a DELIBERATE,
      RECORDED DIVERGENCE from the tokenomics workbook (rev 2026-08-20, Tokenomics section 1),
      which still says "Number of halvings: 6" - see ECON-008 and D-0436.

parameters.name: subsidy_per_block_per_recipient
parameters.raw:
- name: subsidy_per_block_per_recipient
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {source_only: Not exported as a FRAME constant; verified against source only.}
    value: 8
    unit: FLOP
    decision: D-0436
    description: >
      ERA-0 per-block subsidy to EACH of FLOP Labs and FLOP Foundation (16 FLOP/block combined;
      yellowpaper §9), on top of the 96 FLOP block reward. D-0435 (tokenomics workbook
      rev 2026-08-20; ECON-008 §2.2) raised it from 5 and made it HALVE with the block reward,
      on the same 63,072,000-block
      halving boundaries (`era(b) = ⌊b / H⌋`); D-0436 then ran it for ALL FIVE halvings instead of three, so it
      terminates exactly where the reward floors. Per recipient by era: 8 (years 1-2), 4, 2, 1,
      0.5 (years 9-10), then exactly 0 from era 5. Combined per block: 16, 8, 4, 2, 1, then 0.
      Era 4's 0.5 FLOP is fractional in FLOP but EXACT in base units (5 × 10^17 of 10^18), so the
      integer shift never truncates. With genesis block 0 unrewarded (R9.7) and exclusive sunset block
      `SubsidyEndBlock` = 315,360,000, the subsidy mints on 315,359,999 produced blocks (`1..=315,359,999`,
      63,071,999 in era 0 and 63,072,000 in each of eras 1–4): total over the schedule =
      63,072,000 × (16+8+4+2+1) − 16 = 1,955,231,984 FLOP (1,955,232,000 in the H-blocks-per-era closed
      form before subtracting unrewarded block 0). Supersedes the 2026-06-24 flat-5, era-0-only decision
      and D-0435's three-era cap.
    implementations:
      - { file: pallets/pallets/flop-subsidy/src/lib.rs, expect: "SUBSIDY_INITIAL_PER_BLOCK: u128 = 8_000_000_000_000_000_000" }
      - { file: ai-agent-simulator/params.yaml,          expect: "labs_rate: 8" }
      - { file: ai-agent-simulator/params.yaml,          expect: "foundation_rate: 8" }

parameters.name: subsidy_duration_blocks
parameters.raw:
- name: subsidy_duration_blocks
    mutability: runtime-upgrade-only
    on_chain: {source_only: Not exported as a FRAME constant; verified against source only.}
    value: 315_360_000
    unit: blocks
    decision: D-0436
    description: >
      Exclusive subsidy sunset block (~3650 days = 10 years = 5 × halving_interval_blocks), at and
      after which (`now >= SubsidyEndBlock`) `on_initialize` mints 0. With genesis block 0 unrewarded,
      produced blocks `1..=315,359,999` (315,359,999 blocks) mint the subsidy. D-0435 extended it from
      63,072,000 (~730 days) to 189,216,000 in lockstep with making the rate halve; D-0436 extended it
      again to 5 × halving_interval_blocks so the subsidy tracks the reward's halving phase and
      TERMINATES on the same boundary (`b = 315,360,000`) where the reward floors (era 5). Unlike the
      reward it has no floor: era >= 5 pays exactly 0.
    implementations:
      - { file: pallets/pallets/flop-subsidy/src/lib.rs, expect: "SUBSIDY_DURATION_BLOCKS: u64 = 315_360_000" }
      - { file: ai-agent-simulator/params.yaml,          expect: "end_block: 315360000" }
